sourceMethod: Followed MAA's three equal-pair cases, adding explicit coverage and intersection checks.

review.mathCheck: The three equal-pair cases give \(x=1,y\le7\); \(y=7,x\le1\); and \(y=x+6,x\ge1\). Their union consists of three rays meeting only at \((1,7)\), including the all-equal case. Choice E is correct.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded presentation of official solution 9 across pages 3–4. All three cases and directions agree with the official graph; the added completeness statement correctly handles the common endpoint.
review.annotationCheck: The ray, linear-function graph, and supporting inequality nodes fit the worked method. The function-graph node applies to the nonvertical branches; it need not cover the vertical ray by itself.
